name: Men's service cap (wheel cap) for the Honor Guard, rear chinstrap down under the chin
size_basis: Not dimensioned in CAPR 39-1 beyond the 1 3/4 in band braid (6.2.1.1.1). Scaled so the band is 7.4 in across (head ~22.5 in, as in base-art/hats.js); proportions read from CAPR 39-1 Fig A5-8 / A5-9 front views. The chinstrap loop is 0.42 in across (the figure: 18 px at the figure's 43.6 px/in cap scale, 0.41 in at the bottom; 22 px, 0.50 in, down the sides), centre line from the buttons 6.9 in apart (the figure: 309 px = 7.1 in) round the outside of the visor, its centre line 0.28 in below the visor's lowest point (outer edge 0.49 in).
provenance: drawn from CAPR 39-1 Fig A5-8 (front views of the four men's service caps); crown ellipse, visor and cloud/bolt/dart placement read off the 10x render (base-art/rank-traces/capdev-src/cap_*_10x.png); no cap was measured; the strap loop measured on the Class A guard figure of "CAP Honor Guard Uniform Guidance" (page 4, 6x render, crop origin 780,2530: crown 493 px across = 43.6 px/in, strap legs 22 px wide at x 359..380 px on the left and 650..671 px on the right at y 245, bottom outline at y 402 px, 120 px = 2.75 in below the visor's lowest point, buckle slash at x 430..447, y 357..373, slide at x 565..605, y 372..388); drawn as a loop of a leather strap, buckle on the wearer's right (the viewer's left): 9.6.7.9.2 puts the buckle to the right of centre seen from the rear
landmarks_note: rects are {x,y,w,h} in user units (0.01 in); device_slot is a nominal 2 in box centred where the CAP service cap insignia sits (centred on the front of the crown)

dimensions.chinstrap_position: down: black leather strap from the two chrome cap buttons under the chin
dimensions.device: cap-device-cadet-officer-service at device_slot_center (every Honor Guard member, 9.6.7.9)
dimensions.seating: same seating as every service cap (garment_attach_center on the garment's hat_attach, else top_center + 0.25 in). The figure has no head, so there is no chin for the strap to pass under: the loop is drawn round the outside of the visor, its centre line 0.28 in under the visor's lowest point (the guidance figure drops it 2.75 in under the visor, over the face)

documented: male service cap with Cadet Officer cap device and rear chinstrap, worn by all Honor Guard members (CAPR 39-1 9.6.7.9, 9.6.1.2)

the black leather rear chin strap is held up by the two chrome cap buttons with the wings up, buckle right of centre seen from the rear; during a performance it is worn down under the chin (9.6.7.9.2)
assumed: all dimensions except the band height
cloud, bolt and dart ornaments are geometric (cumulus lobes, serrated strip, arrow) laid along the visor edge as on the figure, not the embroidered pattern
visor drawn as a bowl 7.1 in wide and 1.9 in deep (read off the figure, about 1.85 in deep against the 7.4 in band)
crown drawn as an ellipse 11.5 in wide and 2.8 in from its top to the band top: the figure scales to 2.63 in, raised so the 2.375 in device (Vanguard) keeps the figure's clear space above it
cloud centres, sizes and bolt lengths read off the 1860 px figure (u, offset and size tables in build-caps.js), cloud shapes are stylised lobes
the strap's lowest point: its centre line 0.28 in under the visor (no head or chin is drawn to hold it lower)
buckle and slide are drawn as the figure shows them, small nickel slash and a leather loop
